articles.author: Chandrima Sanyal
articles.headline: The Hidden Truth About ETFs And 401(k)s: Tax Advantages Aren't Everything
articles.summary: ETF tax advantages matter less in 401(k)s and IRAs. For retirement savers, low fees, employer matches, and steady investing may be more important.
articles._summary: The ETF industry’s biggest selling point may not matter as much as investors think, at least not inside retirement accounts. ETFs have attracted trillions of dollars in assets partly because of their tax-efficient structure. Unlike mutual funds, ETFs can generally avoid distributing taxable capital gains through their in-kind creation and redemption mechanism. In taxable brokerage accounts, that advantage can add meaningful after-tax returns over time.
articles._zh_headline: 关于 ETF 和 401(k) 的隐藏真相：税收优惠并不是一切
articles._zh_summary: ETF行业的最大卖点可能并不像投资者想象的那么重要，至少在退休账户内不是这样。 ETF 吸引了数万亿美元的资产，部分原因是其节税结构。与共同基金不同，ETF 通常可以通过其实物创建和赎回机制避免分配应税资本利得。在应税经纪账户中，随着时间的推移，这种优势可以增加有意义的税后回报。

articles._summary: South Korea’s benchmark KOSPI suffered a near-vertical drop on Tuesday, June 23, plunging 10% – its steepest fall since March and one of the five largest single-day declines in the index’s history. The slide was severe enough to trip a market-wide circuit breaker, freezing trading for 20 minutes. For U.S. investors, the move showed up in the iShares MSCI South Korea ETF (NYSE: EWY ) , which fell 12.25% on Tuesday — a one-day drop the fund has registered only a handful of times in roughly 25 years.

articles.headline: Qualcomm Eyes TikTok Parent ByteDance For Custom Chip Design Services: Report
articles.summary: Qualcomm is reportedly in talks with ByteDance to design custom AI chips and VPUs, with mass production eyed by year-end.
articles._summary: Global chip supplier Qualcomm Inc. (NASDAQ: QCOM ) is reportedly in talks with China’s ByteDance to provide custom chip-design services. If the deal materializes, the TikTok parent would become an early customer of Qualcomm’s chip-design services operation, Reuters reported on Wednesday. The proposed chips for ByteDance would partially utilize technology from AlphaWave Semi , a high-speed connectivity company acquired by Qualcomm last year.
articles._zh_headline: 高通关注 TikTok 母公司字节跳动提供定制芯片设计服务：报告
articles._zh_summary: 据报道，全球芯片供应商高通公司（纳斯达克股票代码：QCOM）正在与中国字节跳动进行谈判，以提供定制芯片设计服务。据路透社周三报道，如果交易落实，TikTok 母公司将成为高通芯片设计服务业务的早期客户。字节跳动拟议的芯片将部分利用 AlphaWave Semi 的技术，AlphaWave Semi 是一家去年被高通收购的高速连接公司。
